events.did: Scrolled through the contacts on her EON-issued cell until she found the contact she was looking for
events.quote_anchor: She straddled the bench, and scrolled through the contacts until she found what she was looking for.

events.did: Told Rios to meet her at the Iverly Hotel, in room 601
events.quote_anchor: The Iverly Hotel,” said June. “Room 601. Wait for me there.

events.did: Dropped the EON-issued cell into the half-filled basin and watched the screen flicker and die
events.quote_anchor: She dropped it in the half-filled basin, watched it take on water until the screen flickered, died.

events.did: Appeared in the parking garage wearing sunglasses on his nose hours after the sun had gone down
events.quote_anchor: Maybe it was the sunglasses perched on his nose, despite the fact the sun had gone down hours ago.

events.did: Saw that Noah's eyes were no longer warm and brown but wild swirls of white and blue and gray
events.quote_anchor: No longer warm and brown and bright, but wild swirls of white and blue and gray.

events.did: Dropped through the floor of the parking garage as soon as Noah turned toward the vehicle
events.quote_anchor: As soon as Noah turned toward the vehicle, Rios dropped through the floor.

events.did: Twisted out of the way of the cattle prod, caught the baton and kicked the tactical agent in the chest
events.quote_anchor: Rios twisted out of the way, dodging the violent blue tip, and caught the baton, kicking the agent in the chest as hard as she could.

events.did: Stepped out of nothing in front of the stairwell door and drove the tip of a baton into Rios's chest
events.quote_anchor: You shouldn’t have run,” he said, the last word swallowed by the crackle of static as he drove the tip of a baton into her chest.

relations.did: Always liked Noah, and let him step closer because the car at her back left her nowhere to go
relations.quote_anchor: She let him because she’d always liked him. And because with the car at her back, there was nowhere else to go.

relations.did: A voice that echoed in Rios's head while she fought the tactical agent
relations.quote_anchor: As if he couldn’t feel it. Charlotte’s voice echoed in her head.
